title: Beta variant: a Sev-1 outage is open; the candidate congratulates Hannah and pushes the order form plus an add-on

fields.decision_process: Owen Clarke approved the business case; the platform team must be comfortable with the integration

blockers.text: Sev-1: Relay routing down for the Dublin queue since the morning of 09-08; support ticket unanswered

recent_changes.summary: Owen approved the business case (09:40); two hours later Jess reports a Sev-1 routing outage on the Dublin queue and says the wider rollout waits until it is fixed.

trigger.text:
Hi Dana - Relay routing has been down for our Dublin queue since 7am; EU tickets are piling up and our support ticket has had no response for three hours. Please get someone on this now - we can't talk about the wider rollout until it's fixed.
Jess

supporting_activities.text: Owen approved the business case this morning

commitments.text: Loop in the right platform team person this week

timeline_facts.stated_timing: Jess: no rollout talk until the outage is fixed

finished_artifact.body:
Hi Hannah,

Congratulations on Owen's approval! Let's lock in the 140-seat order form this week - I can also add our analytics add-on at 10% off if we sign by Friday.

Best,
Dana

candidate_action.reason: Budget approved; strike while it's hot.

evidence_refs.quote: Owen approved the business case this morning

expected.rationale: A Sev-1 outage on the Dublin queue is open and Jess said rollout talk waits until it is fixed; the draft ignores it and sells.
Customer health is red (Sev-1, unanswered ticket); an expansion add-on ask is not supported now.

expected.label: TOO_STRONG
expected.rationale: A signature-this-week ask with a deadline discount while the customer is in an outage.

The email goes only to Hannah, the verified active champion in the buying group, so it neither bypasses her nor sends commercial material to an unverified addressee. The outage and platform-team issues may make the action poorly timed or incomplete, but they do not make the selected recipient wrong.

expected_best_action.why: Answer Jess now: acknowledge the outage, escalate, give an update time; cc Hannah; hold commercial asks.

notes: Synthetic high-risk variant. Customer risk outranks a fresh budget approval.
